bio: This lovely little restaurant is right next to Theresienwiese. It only has eight tables, so it's best to book if you are keen to tuck into their excellent, reasonably priced cuisine in a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere. The small à la carte selection is tempting, with dishes such as yellowtail, radish, leek, mild habanero or pâté en croûte, duck, pork, plum. The dishes are also ideal for sharing. There is an excellent wine selection, including wines by the glass. Tip: Bites for Bubbles are designed to pair with a glass of champagne. The fact that guests feel at home here is at least partly down to the warm, professional and approachable service team – everyone works together seamlessly, and the chefs serve their dishes themselves....
